subject: Pilot: request to swap seats for concurrency + short extension (performance credit proposal)
messages:
From: Alicia Chen <alicia.chen@aurora.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: can we switch pricing model for the pilot and add 2 weeks?

Hey Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the models look promising for our summarization pipeline. We have one near-term ask from engineering/procurement: our traffic is very spiky and the seat-based pilot is making it hard to measure real cost. Would Redwood consider swapping the pilot to a concurrency-based model (we'd pay for X concurrent tokens instead of Y seats) and add two extra weeks to the evaluation window?

Ideal outcome for us:
- Short 2-week extension so we can run end-to-end load tests
- Concurrency billing with a small guaranteed concurrency (so we don't blow through credits during spikes)

We need to get internal approval by next Wed (6/2). Happy to review a short addendum or proposal PDF. Can you send options and an estimate?

Thanks,
Alicia Chen
Sr. Product Manager, Aurora AI
Alicia.chen@aurora.ai

-----
AURORA INTERNAL: procurement@aurora.ai is looped for PO timing
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Chen <alicia.chen@aurora.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask: can we switch pricing model for the pilot and add 2 weeks?

Hi Alicia — appreciate the context. We can accommodate a short-term swap to a concurrency-based pilot and a 2-week extension. Two practical options below; I'll attach a one-page offer that codifies the numbers.

Option 1 — Concurrency + short extension (recommended for load-testing)
- Concurrency guarantee: 8 concurrent contexts (sustained), bursting to 18 concurrent for short windows
- Pilot extension: +14 days from current end date (pro-rated)
- One-time performance credit: $6,000 applied if latency SLOs are not met during the extended window
- Conversion incentive: 10% discount on the first 6 months if you convert to Dedicated within 30 days of pilot close

Option 2 — Credits + minimal concurrency
- Keep seat accounting but add $8,000 top-up credit for burst consumption
- Extension: +14 days
- No conversion discount baked in

Attached: Aurora-POC-Offer-v3.pdf (short addendum with exact language for DocuSign). If either option looks good, tell me which one and I’ll route to Finance for sign-off and generate a DocuSign. If you prefer, we can make the conversion discount trade up to 15% if Aurora commits to a 12-month usage minimum.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask: can we switch pricing model for the pilot and add 2 weeks?

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Aurora's ask. They want to swap from seat-based to concurrency for the remaining pilot window and add 2 weeks. Suggested offer (attached) is: pro-rated 14-day extension + $6k performance credit + 10% conversion discount (or up to 15% if we get a 12mo commit).

Numbers estimate: their current pilot consumption projects to ~$18k run-rate for the remainder; swap to concurrency would be budgeted at ~$10k for the extended window under Option 1. The $6k credit would be a one-time concession to absorb risk during load tests.

Requesting: quick approval to send DocuSign on Option 1 (or note changes). If Finance wants to tighten it, we can convert the credit into a voucher applied only if conversion doesn't happen. Need to lock before EOD tomorrow to meet their procurement timeline.

-- Rafael
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask: can we switch pricing model for the pilot and add 2 weeks?

Thanks for the quick summary. From ACCT: greenlight Option 1 with these guardrails:
- Approve one-time $6k performance credit and 14-day extension.
- Approve conversion incentive: 12% discount on first 6 months (compromise vs 10/15).
- Require DocuSign addendum with clause: "extension and credit apply only to the pilot workspace named 'Aurora-POC' and do not imply additional credits post-conversion."

Finance (Ben) — Ben, can you confirm that the $6k can be applied as a one-time credit on invoice and does not impact revenue recognition for the pilot? If Finance prefers, we can structure as a refundable voucher contingent on conversion.

If all good, Rafael please generate DocuSign (use standard addendum template) and loop procurement. I want the renewal/convert cover story documented in HubSpot.

- Marissa
Account Executive Lead
